{{Quote|I'll ask you how you got loose from Rokur Gepta later, if we live. Meanwhile, hadn't you better man the quad-guns?|[[Vuffi Raa]] to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="LCatSoT" />}}
The '''Battle of Oseon''' was a minor skirmish between the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the [[Renatasian Confederation]], in the year [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

==Prelude==
After years of searching, members of the [[Renatasian Confederation]] known as [[Zero Squadron]], had tracked [[Vuffi Raa]] to the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]]. Believing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to be the [[Butcher of Renatasia]], they intended to destroy him along with his associate, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Having discovered that the pair was on a private [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belonging to [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]], the five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] commenced strafing runs on the asteroid's [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome, determined to destroy their long-standing foe.

==The Battle==
Having escaped the exploding mansion complex, Calrissian made his way to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and made lift-off. As the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] entered [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], it was beset by the five remaining [[Starfighter/Legends|fightercraft]] of [[Zero Squadron]], led by [[Klyn Shanga]]. After a few unsuccessful passes, [[Vuffi Raa]] executed a [[Luftberry circle]], which resulted in the battle's first casualty. Seeking revenge, a second [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] made an error, and came within the sights of the ''Falcon's'' [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad-guns]], ending his fight. Thinking their intended victim was still on the asteroid, the three remaining ships decided to launch the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] they were using for [[Hyperdrive/Legends|interstellar]] travel toward the surface. Unfortunately, one of the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor]] cables would not release, drawing a third pilot to his doom. The resulting explosion destroyed a fourth starfighter, and disabling the fifth, while the ''Millennium Falcon'' escaped without harm.

==Outcome==
The last remaining pilot was rescued by the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' and brought onboard. Klyn Shanga would not believe that Vuffi Raa was, in fact, a droid, and maintained he was [[Sentience/Legends|organic]] and remained the ''Butcher of Renatasia''. Having pity on the aged [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], Vuffi Raa persuaded Lando to transport him to the nearest [[Planet/Legends|port]], and release him; which is exactly what they did.

The small, private fleet of fighters that Bohhuah Mutdah employed in defense of his home were never launched, and were suspiciously absent in the battle.
